name: HAME-NeRF
definition: A framework for extracting high-fidelity, textured surface meshes from RGB images by defining volume density as a Secant Hyperbolic Function applied to a Signed Distance Function (SDF), with a spatially-varying sharpness parameter β(x) learned via an MLP.
summary: HAME-NeRF extracts high-fidelity textured meshes from RGB images using a spatially-varying sharpness parameter and iterative differentiable mesh refinement for superior geometric accuracy.
